sources.title: Comprehensive & Land Use Plan
admitted_facts: Comprehensive Plan adopted in 2022 with an approximately 20-year planning horizon into the 2040s.
Plan explicitly covers land use/urban design, transportation/connectivity, housing/neighborhoods, parks/wellness, economic development, and public facilities/infrastructure.

sources.title: Plans and Projects
admitted_facts: City planning surface includes metropolitan transportation, transit, active transportation, airport, safety, and transportation-improvement planning.

sources.title: Public Works & Transportation
admitted_facts: Department responsibilities include airport, mass transit, landfill, streets, stormwater, and sewage treatment.
Mobility modes explicitly include transit, freight, automobiles, walking, air, and biking.

sources.title: Utility Services
admitted_facts: Water utility surface identifies Missouri American Water.
Gas utility surface identifies Spire Energy.

sources.title: City of St. Joseph official homepage
admitted_facts: City homepage exposes high-level fast facts including population, parks/facilities, trails/parkway, licensed businesses, and commute time.
Homepage population figure differs from the Census 2025 estimate; this discrepancy is preserved rather than reconciled in PASS-0.

unresolved.note: Public surfaces report different population figures/vintages. PASS-0 does not force a single value where provenance differs.
